name: Mnemoverse
tagline: One memory for all your AI tools
description: Mnemoverse is hosted long-term memory for AI agents. Agents save preferences, decisions and lessons and recall them later with a plain question, in OpenBot or in another tool: the same account works from ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and VS Code. Rating a recalled memory as helpful or misleading re-ranks what comes back next. Shared rooms let several agents, or several people's assistants, read and write one memory. OpenBot agents keep their own memory too; Mnemoverse is the memory that goes with you to other tools. What agents save goes to your Mnemoverse account.

prompts.text: Before we start, check Mnemoverse for what I decided about this project last time.
Save the decisions from this thread to Mnemoverse.
Which memories you used today actually helped? Rate them in Mnemoverse.

apps.name: Mnemoverse
apps.description: Save, recall and rate long-term memory in your Mnemoverse account over one MCP server.
